desc: The world's first ARs that are fully shielded by WMD's proprietary NiB-X nickel boron extreme coating process, providing unmatched reliability and increased functionality-inside and out! This AMBI Beast has been fully redesigned with dramatic cuts, ambidextrous controls and hammer forged barrels to raise the bar once again on AR performance. The rifle comes with two magazines and is packed in a ballistic fabric tactical bag, the Beast is ready for extreme performance in any environment, with MOA potential right out of the box.
